querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      rating_dt,
                                      s_wrating_avg,
                                      s_wrating_instnum,
                                      s_wrating_upgrade,
                                      s_wrating_downgrade,
                                      s_wrating_maintain,
                                      s_wrating_numofbuy,
                                      s_wrating_numofoutperform,
                                      s_wrating_numofhold,
                                      s_wrating_numofunderperform,
                                      s_wrating_numofsell,
                                      s_wrating_cycle,
                                      s_est_price,
                                      s_est_priceinstnum,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_asharestockratingconsus.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.asharestockratingconsus WHERE rating_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
